summary.est_token_yield_if_all_reviewed_approved: 210M–510M (all NEEDS_LICENSE_REVIEW + NEEDS_OWNER_CREDENTIALS + NEEDS_ACCESS sources combined conservative-to-best-case)
summary.estimate_note: All estimates are preliminary. Actual yield depends on: (a) Belarusian language subset actually existing in each corpus, (b) dedup against existing v3b, (c) cross-source dedup between web corpora which dramatically reduces net yield when using multiple CommonCrawl-derived sources
recommended_owner_review_order: 1. S16 OSCAR-2301 — largest yield, gated HF access, legal posture decision needed
2. S21 FineWeb2 — best quality web corpus, verify be subset exists
3. S24 bnkorpus — potentially largest unique Belarusian data, access uncertain
4. S18 HPLT v2 — large yield, verify be availability
5. S26 Belacorpus — small but high quality, local, clear attribution
6. S04 OPUS OpenSubtitles — 10-40M tokens, copyright question
7. S03 Books batch 2 — moderate yield, per-book copyright
8. S25 Leipzig — moderate yield, verify terms
9. S27 Belarusian news — check if already in CommonCrawl first
10. Remaining OPUS subcorpora, GlotCC, MADLAD, CulturaX — cross-source dedup critical
summary.web_corpus_dedup_strategy_note: S16(OSCAR), S17(CulturaX), S18(HPLT), S19(GlotCC), S20(MADLAD), S21(FineWeb2), S22(CC100), S23(mC4) are ALL derived from CommonCrawl. Using more than 1-2 of these yields diminishing returns due to extreme overlap. Pick 1-2 based on quality+license, not all.
summary.target_achievable_with_1_web_corpus: YES (59M + 8M approved + 30-60M from one web corpus → 97M–127M conservative; with books+subtitles → 120M–160M)
summary.target_achievable_best_case: YES (59M + 16M approved + 100M web + 50M other reviewed → ~225M, in 200-300M target)
